== Biography ==
'''Janet Glasgow''' was baptised at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 14 Aug 1703. The parish register names her father as [[Glasgow-2475|John Glasgow]] and her mother as [[Kyle-2471|Isabell Kelle]].<ref name="FMP1" /> Because the entry records a baptism rather than a birth, her birth is placed before that date, and Irvine is inferred from the baptism rather than independently recorded.

Janet Glasgow was one of the children recorded to John Glasgow and Isabell Kelle in the Irvine register, alongside [[Glasgow-4119|Margaret]] (1708), [[Glasgow-4100|James]] (1711), [[Glasgow-4102|Mary]] (1713).

== Research Notes ==
The baptism is the only record found for Janet Glasgow; it establishes her parents and baptism but gives no later life, marriage or death.

A possible identification concerns Joannet Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Joannet Glasgow and Andrew Allexander/ on 8 August 1661 at Glasgow.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 644 / 1/230 / 230; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
